title: Point Pool Allocator with Stable Addresses
hints: Never grow a block in place, because that would move points. Keep a list of fixed-size blocks (e.g. `std::vector<std::unique_ptr<Point3[]>>`) and allocate a NEW block when the last one is full.
Track how many slots of the LAST block are used. Earlier blocks are always full (freed slots go to the free list instead).
Free list: `std::vector<Point3*>`. deallocate pushes, and allocate pops from the back first (LIFO = cache-hot reuse).
